periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward from the transverse facial plane toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the major axis approximately 1.8 times the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial margin, creating a teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape along the posterior margin with negligible apical indentation.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Uniform thickness across the torso, occupying approximately 25% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation distance, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear structure.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semi-circular apex with high curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive tan/brown pigmentation on typically white pelage regions.
